market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month traded at ~$102 on May 1 with intraday high $106.62, after a near-$111 monthly peak on April 30 amid Middle East tensions and UAE OPEC+ exit. With 30 days in May and recent volatility showing $110+ is reachable, hitting $110 again is plausible but not certain given recent profit-taking.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether geopolitical risk premium persists or unwinds; OPEC+ supply response.
